input.summary:
North store is lit: 0 dark, 0 dim, min light 8 on all 328 floor cells, with five standing lanterns added at the end of parts/room-11.mjs build().
The five lanterns are at (33,13,13), (31,13,5), (24,13,5), (9,13,13) and (3,15,5); the last sits on the west rack's top log.
Each was tested by removing it and re-measuring; (24,13,5) and (3,15,5) were confirmed needed. make.sh passes and the room reads OK.
left: The lanterns were placed where the light tool named them. The room designer should look at the five floor lanterns and confirm they don't spoil the store's lanes, since the brief asked for lanterns that look placed.
The dim cells the designer named (east and west ends) are cleared, but the last two cells to clear were mid-south at (15,13,13) and (16,13,13); the lanterns at (9,13,13) and (31,13,5) cover them.
Other rooms still have dark or dim cells, outside this part: Loft 104 dim (min 4), Keepers' gallery 10 dim (min 5), Counting room 2 dim, Cart passage 2 dim. Their lamplighters should handle them.
Walk note: 40 floor cells are reported unreached, mostly rack-top cells at y15 (mcd walk does not climb); this is not a lighting problem and I did not touch it.

waste.what: Chose lamp spots by trial: edit room-11.mjs, run make.sh, re-measure, then remove and restore each lantern to test whether it was needed.
waste.cost: About 6 full make.sh + room-check cycles and 4 manual edits (including one failed sed).
waste.tool: `mcd room --try-lamps "x,y,z;..."` (or an overlay file) that measures a candidate lamp set without a rebuild, and prints the minimal set that clears the dim cells.

waste.what: The tool's 'lifts N cells' figure is per candidate, not additive; I had to measure the union of the lamps myself.
waste.cost: Two extra measurement rounds to find the combined set.
waste.tool: `mcd room --rooms ... --suggest` should run greedy set cover over the dim cells and report the combined lift and the lamp count it needs.

waste.what: The brief's MCD="node .../mcd.mjs" fails as `$MCD room ...` under zsh (no word splitting), so the first measurement call errored.
waste.cost: One failed call and a retry with the node path written out.
waste.tool: Give the brief a wrapper script (e.g. an `mcd` shim on PATH) or write the command as `node <path>/mcd.mjs`, and say so in the brief.

waste.what: Re-ran the whole 21-part make.sh to re-measure one room after each lantern tweak.
waste.cost: About 6 full builds for a change inside one room.
waste.tool: A room-only rebuild, or `mcd room` reading a lamp overlay file so the lamplighter can test lights without re-running the build.

companions.task: Look at the five standing lanterns on the floor (two at the east end, one on the west rack top, two mid-store) and confirm they don't spoil the store's lanes or the desk focal point.
